fixed_evidence.text: Packing specification for this shipment: each carton contains 8 units.
Receiving record: 3 units were damaged in transit and are not usable.

question: How many usable units remain, and how many were originally shipped? Show how the records combine and state any limitation.

semantic_content.answer: Originally shipped: 96 units (12 cartons × 8 units/carton). Subject to the records referring to the same shipment and the 3 damaged units being included in that shipment, usable units remaining: 93 (96 − 3). The records do not expressly establish that every shipped carton was received or rule out further losses, damage, or exclusions; thus 93 is a conditional net based only on the stated transit damage.
